question: Do Kodak's current official Digital LAD downloads provide exact machine-readable DPX/Cineon test-image code values and documented recorder/print density semantics sufficient for a bounded neutral calibration primitive?
claim_ceiling: Kodak motion-picture film-recorder and print-chain neutral calibration source audit; not a camera-to-film operator, stock colour response, measured local process result, scanner profile, still-film calibration or product promotion

acquisition.rights_boundary: Current official Kodak downloads without an explicit reusable-data licence in the audited page. Internal factual and interoperability research only; do not redistribute the PDFs, archives or extracted images.

required_observations.guide_defines_printing_density: Printing Density = 0.002 * 10-bit code value for the CINEON negative calibration aim.
required_observations.guide_defines_lad_code: The recommended Digital LAD patch is code 445 in all three channels.

allowed_after_pass: freeze an exact Cineon/DPX decoder and neutral code-to-printing-density primitive
test negative and interpositive branches separately against the documented tables
use the Digital LAD image as a format and neutral calibration fixture
compare existing U2.2 and U6.P6 print/scan domain semantics without changing completed gates
forbidden: treat the Digital LAD image as a photographic scene pair or colour-style target
infer a camera-to-film or digital-to-film operator
infer stock colour rendering, grain, halation, MTF or scanner response
treat manufacturer aim tables as measurements from the user's lab, process or scanner

branch_rule.source_pass: Open one exact neutral code-to-density and container-interoperability primitive with no style fitting.
branch_rule.format_or_pixel_mismatch: Retain the guide tables as documentation-only evidence and close the machine-readable fixture route.
branch_rule.rights_or_source_failure: Delete incomplete owned acquisition, retain only factual source metadata and continue another ready physical or identifying-data leaf.

execution_amendments.change: bind exact current official payload identities without changing any source, threshold or decision rule
execution_amendments.scientific_effect: none; archive inventory and any decode remain governed by the original frozen gates
